resources.string: Sets android:extractNativeLibs to true when it is false.
Hides the chosen packages from the app\'s PackageManager queries, as if they were not installed.
Package names the app must not see.
Native libraries for other architectures under lib/ are deleted, including from split APKs.
Removes native libraries for every CPU architecture except the selected one to shrink the APK.
Log detailed runtime diagnostics from the extension and its native library under the SignatureKiller logcat tag.

Spoofs the original app signature and redirects reads of the installed APK files to embedded original copies. Only use this for apps that verify the APK files themselves; it roughly doubles the APK size.
